annotations.title: Put a preset on a modeler

description: Puts a real amp's preset on the player's modeler: what 'put / load / send the <amp> on (or to) my <modeler>' asks for, on Axe-Fx II, Axe-Fx III, FM3, FM9 or Helix. With send_to_modeler it goes straight to the modeler connected in the player's open gridleak.app tab and loads into the edit buffer; no editor app (Axe-Edit, HX Edit) and no control of the computer is involved. Takes the amp's catalog id (canonical_id, e.g. 'marshall/jcm800_2204'). Without send_to_modeler it downloads the preset file. Returns a short-lived signed URL (valid 5 minutes) and preset metadata. Needs a Gridleak account. The player signs in when their assistant asks, or the client sends a Gridleak access token. Each new preset uses one of the account's monthly free presets; Pro has no monthly limit. Lead with install_url: it opens the preset on Gridleak, which installs it straight to the player's connected modeler or saves the file. Offer download_url as the direct file link. Don't fetch either yourself; assistant sandboxes usually can't reach them.

device.description: Target modeler device for the download.

send_to_modeler.description: Send the preset straight to this modeler, connected in the player's open gridleak.app tab, instead of returning a file link. Use it only when the player asks to put a preset on their modeler. It loads into the edit buffer, with an undo in Gridleak; a saved slot, or a player who turned assistant sends off, confirms there. The answer's send.status is done, waiting (call again with the same arguments to check), declined, failed or no_tab (no tab with this modeler connected: lead with install_url). It counts as one free preset only when it installs.
